title: Ramayana: Part One crosses Rs 100 crore net in India in two days, trackers estimate
dek: Second-day estimates range from Rs 34 crore to Rs 48 crore net as collections dip from the opening; the producers have not published figures.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ramayana: Part One has taken more than Rs 100 crore net at the Indian box office in its first two days, according to the latest estimate from a box office tracking site, though figures for its second day vary widely and the producers have not released their own.

The tracker's estimate, updated at 10:17 pm on Friday and cited in reports, put the second-day collection at Rs 48.05 crore net, taking the two-day total to Rs 112.90 crore net, or Rs 134.80 crore gross. An earlier live estimate from the same site, at 8:03 pm, had the second day at Rs 34.06 crore and the total just under Rs 100 crore, so the final figure may change. Either way, collections fell from the estimated Rs 64.85 crore net on the opening day, Thursday.

The Hindi version earned about Rs 35.50 crore of Friday's total in the later estimate, followed by the Kannada (Rs 5.15 crore), Telugu (Rs 4.75 crore), Tamil (Rs 1.50 crore) and Malayalam (Rs 1.15 crore) versions. The dubbed southern versions again filled a larger share of their seats than the Hindi one. One report put the worldwide gross at about Rs 220 crore, including about Rs 85 crore from overseas.

Box office numbers in India remain estimates until producers publish their own. The film's first weekend will be the first real test of how well it holds up.
